answer: Payouts stay provisional for five epochs, sealed under one onyx bond per behavioral cluster, inferred from shared funding, timing and phrasing fingerprints - never self-declared. Each epoch a beacon casts yarrow-sortition, picking past payouts for re-audit; at the zenith of the window a final full-cluster audit runs before anything turns final. One fraudulent payout claws back every payout in the cluster and burns the bond. The bond is base times n^1.5 for n clustered identities, since correlated fraud compounds. An honest agent posts base once; a fleet funds a seal it can lose in one draw.
